description: This bar chart, from the paper "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the ratio (expressed as a percentage) of knowledge representation for three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, while the vertical axis, labeled "Ratio (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each domain, three bars are grouped side-by-side, representing the respective model's performance ratio. In the "Movies" category, the ratios are approximately 90% for Llama3, 90% for Qwen2, and 72% for ChatGPT. In the "Songs" category, the ratios are approximately 85% for Llama3, 90% for Qwen2, and 62% for ChatGPT. In the "Basketball" category, the ratios are approximately 67% for Llama3, 57% for Qwen2, and 61% for ChatGPT. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories as labeled on the x-axis. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps the colors to the respective models. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their standard presentation.
